concern: This calls fitBounds and changes the camera. Fit design can imply changing the geometry or checking whether the design fits.
Workspace exposes the application's structure. The visitor is opening a map view.

en: Loading the street map sends your IP address and the map area to OpenFreeMap and its delivery network. Street-map data is a reference for orientation.
de: Wenn Sie die Straßenkarte laden, erhalten OpenFreeMap und die beteiligten Dienste Ihre IP-Adresse und Angaben zum angezeigten Kartenausschnitt. Die Straßenkarte dient der Orientierung.
concern: Keep the supported IP/service disclosure. Area shown and for orientation are clearer than map area and data is a reference. This wording does not establish privacy or licensing acceptance.
proposed_en: Loading the street map sends your IP address and the area shown to OpenFreeMap and its delivery network. The street map is for orientation.

concern: The link opens OpenFreeMap's privacy page. Naming that destination is clearer than the abstract provider label.

en: Some map resources could not be displayed. Your project geometry is unchanged.
de: Die Karte konnte nicht vollständig angezeigt werden. Die Geometrie Ihres Projekts ist unverändert.
concern: This notice also handles complete initialization or graphics-context failure. Some resources understates those states and exposes an internal term.
proposed_en: The map could not be fully displayed. Your project geometry is unchanged.

en: The map needs a geographic origin and a recorded true-north reference for this design.
de: Die Kartenansicht benötigt einen geografischen Ursprung und einen im Projekt hinterlegten Bezug auf geografisch Nord.

en: The map places your recorded geometry at its geographic reference. Roof dimensions and source accuracy stay as declared in the project.
de: Die Karte zeigt die erfasste Geometrie anhand des geografischen Projektbezugs. Dachmaße und die im Projekt angegebene Quellengenauigkeit bleiben unverändert.
concern: Places geometry at its reference is abstract. Name the display operation and retain declared accuracy so the map cannot imply a survey check.
proposed_en: The map displays your recorded geometry using the project's geographic reference. Roof dimensions and declared source accuracy remain unchanged.

en: The map workspace could not be loaded. Plan view, 3D and numeric properties remain available.
de: Die Karte konnte nicht geladen werden. Sie können weiterhin die Ansicht wechseln oder numerische Eigenschaften bearbeiten.
concern: Workspace is internal language. The boundary can also catch rendering failure, so 3D remains available may overpromise successful graphics rendering. State the surviving UI actions.
proposed_en: The map could not be loaded. You can still switch views or edit numeric properties.

en: This geometry cannot be displayed by the map projection. Plan view, 3D and numeric properties remain available.
de: Diese Geometrie lässt sich auf der Karte nicht darstellen. Sie können weiterhin die Ansicht wechseln oder numerische Eigenschaften bearbeiten.
concern: Name the failed map view without making the projection an actor. State accessible actions rather than an unconditional promise that other renderers will display every rejected geometry.
proposed_en: This geometry cannot be shown on the map. You can still switch views or edit numeric properties.

en: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
de: Zum Zoomen der Karte Strg gedrückt halten und scrollen.

en: Use two fingers to move the map
de: Die Karte mit zwei Fingern verschieben.

en: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
de: Zum Zoomen der Karte ⌘ gedrückt halten und scrollen.
